lesson.coverTitle: 10 words to have a conversation in English
lesson.topic: 10 words to have a conversation in English

yt.intro: English teacher Jackie is a big Youtuber. Watching her Youtube Channel @AskJackie is a great way to study. Today we'll take a look at her video about '10 words to have a conversation in English'. We'll take a look at five of them first. Are you ready?

video.nome: 10 words to have a conversation in English

conversa: Great! / Good! / Okay. Not bad. / Fine.
What's going on in your life?
Nothing / Not much / Not a whole lot / I'm ....

pratica.instrucao: Practice the expressions shown in the video.
itens: How is it going? = How are things? | Great! / Good! / Okay. Not bad. / Fine.
What's going on? = What's happening? = What's up? (very informal) | Nothing / Not much / Not a whole lot / I'm ....

pratica.instrucao: Practice the expressions shown in the video.
itens: How is it going? / How are things?
Ótimo / Bom / Ok, nada mal. / Bem
Great! / Good! / Okay. Not bad. / Fine.
O que está acontecendo? / O que está 'rolando'? / E aí?
What's going on? = What's happening? = What's up?
Nada / Nada demais / Não muito / Eu estou ...
Nothing / Not much / Not a whole lot / I'm ....
Sabe o que eu quero dizer?
